children: Travel to the U.S. by Canadian residents continues to recover. Preliminary data indicate Canadian resident return trips from the neighboring country were up 3% on-year in October to 1.9 million, Statistics Canada says. That marks a seventh straight month of annual growth, and includes a 2.2% increase in trips by automobile and 5.6% rise in air travel. Still, travel remains 29% below October 2024 for automobiles and 19.6% down for air travel. U.S.-resident trips to Canada were up 8.1% overall in October to hit 1.5 million, a ninth straight rise. This includes an 8.7% increase in trips by automobile, and 6.5% rise in air travel by Americans. (robb.stewart@wsj.com; @RobbMStewart)
